summary.text: Aaron Guckian is the Republican nominee for governor. A former Rhode Island Dental Association leader, teacher and banker, he was a special assistant to Gov. Don Carcieri and was the 2022 Republican nominee for lieutenant governor. He campaigns on lowering taxes and fees, opposing a millionaire's tax and truck tolls, and working with the Trump administration.

paragraphs.text: Guckian is an East Greenwich native and a former college basketball player.

He graduated from East Greenwich High School and earned a bachelor's degree in music and education from Connecticut College, a master's degree in music from Rhode Island College and an MBA from Johnson and Wales University; he cites two master's degrees as part of his résumé.
He coaches for the East Greenwich Basketball Association and the East Greenwich Soccer Association, according to Ballotpedia.

Guckian has worked as a teacher and in banking and nonprofit work, including as a vice president at Bank Newport, an officer at The Washington Trust Company and a development officer at the Rhode Island Foundation.
About two decades ago he served as a special assistant to Gov. Don Carcieri, and he most recently led the Rhode Island Dental Association.
Guckian was the Republican nominee for lieutenant governor in 2022 and lost to Democrat Sabina Matos, 43.1 percent to 51.2 percent.
He won the Republican nomination for governor in the September 9, 2026 primary.
